plate.narration: A frost wyrm has claimed the new reading room. Its head rests on a bench, and every sleepy breath paints frost ferns on the wall. The yeti builders wait beside their tools. Somehow, everyone needs room.

goal.text: Make room for the readers and the frost wyrm without waking the old ice.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

arrival.narration: Beyond the memory reading room, yeti builders have stopped carving a new chamber for the memory readers. A frost wyrm has curled across their doorway, using a bench as a pillow. Its breath covers the wall in tiny ice ferns. "Make room for us and the wyrm without waking the old ice," says a builder. "We can move the room. We cannot ask the mountain for a second mountain." The wyrm opens one eye. Pip stays in the old reading room to help the elder sort the notes while you work below.

choices.label: Watch before moving

listen.narration: A chisel scrapes. The wyrm tightens around its bench, then loosens when the builder steps back. Watch the tail and breathing pattern from the far wall. "The bench has become a very expensive pillow," whispers the builder.

choices.label: Continue

watch_check.narration: Watch the wyrm curl, breathe and relax. Echo the observed pattern before anyone marks a lane. The marks describe its reach today, not a command it must obey.

interaction.cue: Watch the nest pattern, then echo it.

onSuccess.narration: You mark the observed reach, with a clear margin.

onFailure.narration: The builder checks the shifting tail and adds a wider margin. Your record names this as a helped observation.

onAssisted.narration: The builder checks the shifting tail and adds a wider margin. Your record names this as a helped observation.

boundary.narration: Help the builders move everything outside that margin. Choose a quiet job; nothing is taken from under the wyrm. One builder knits a hat for a chisel that does not yet have a hat.

options.label: Move the empty stool
options.reaction: The stool is beyond the tail mark.

options.label: Show the no-scrape edge
options.reaction: A builder marks only the new surface.

onSuccess.narration: The builders can prepare a reading place without testing the nest with a foot.

onFailure.narration: The builders can prepare a reading place without testing the nest with a foot.

onAssisted.narration: The builders can prepare a reading place without testing the nest with a foot.

supplies.narration: The readers will need furniture after the encounter. A folded table travels easily if the room must move, but takes more setting up if you win this doorway. Shelf parts make a sturdy low shelf here; after a retreat they must be unpacked into a temporary tabletop. Which kit will you carry?

choices.label: Carry the folding table kit
Carry the low-shelf parts

table_kit.narration: Level the folded table before carrying it to the safe alcove. It folds very small. The builder briefly folds the instruction sheet into something much larger.

interaction.cue: Level the folded table for carrying.

onSuccess.narration: The portable kit waits outside the nest.

onFailure.narration: The portable kit waits outside the nest.

onAssisted.narration: The portable kit waits outside the nest.

shelf_kit.narration: Pass the wide shelf blocks and bundled top to the alcove. Each bright mark belongs to the builders; none is a piece of old ice.

interaction.cue: Pass the shelf parts along the safe wall.

onSuccess.narration: The shelf kit waits outside the nest.

onFailure.narration: The shelf kit waits outside the nest.

onAssisted.narration: The shelf kit waits outside the nest.

cold_opening.narration: An opening in the far wall shows a sheltered snow hollow. The Listening Chime is the travelers' chime: its echo checks an open way back; it cannot command a rift. Loose bones rattle on this side, and the builders leave them alone. Check the hollow before inviting any creature into it.

choices.label: Observe the full floor from here
Support a builder checking both sides
Let our starweaver study the opening

hollow_view.narration: Wait for the drifting snow to reveal the whole hollow. Check tracks, floor and the return opening; a boot-shaped lump is only snow.

interaction.cue: Check the hollow during the full clear view.

onSuccess.narration: The floor is unoccupied and the way back remains visible.

onFailure.narration: The far edge was hidden. A builder will check it from the open side before anyone offers the space.

onAssisted.narration: The floor is unoccupied and the way back remains visible.

hollow_help.narration: Support the marker line while the builder clears the hidden drift, checks for tracks and returns. The party stays at the tunnel marker.

interaction.cue: Support the marker line for the builder.

onSuccess.narration: The checked hollow is empty and sheltered.

onFailure.narration: The checked hollow is empty and sheltered.

onAssisted.narration: The checked hollow is empty and sheltered.

hollow_check.narration: Hold the marker line while the builder crosses the visible opening, checks the ground and returns. Nobody tests unknown old ice.

interaction.cue: Support the marker while the builder checks the hollow.

onSuccess.narration: The builder has checked both sides and returned.

onFailure.narration: The builder has checked both sides and returned.

onAssisted.narration: The builder has checked both sides and returned.

hollow_attuned.narration: Your starweaver studies the opening's light while the builders check its echo and empty floor. This replaces the separate viewing task, not the ordinary ground checks. A clear way back is still required.

choices.label: Continue

bed.narration: The hollow is safe. Soft new snow will make a welcoming bowl: on the board, holding its approach for one clear round can invite the wyrm in. A broad slab takes two clear rounds to invite it, but can later be recovered as a low reader step if the hollow stays empty. Neither plan promises the wyrm will cooperate.

choices.label: Shape a soft snow bed
Set a broad slab we can recover if unused

bed_snow.narration: Shape loose new snow into a broad shallow bowl without taking anything from the nest. Level the base so the hollow still has a clear exit.

onSuccess.narration: The softer bed needs one clear held round to invite the wyrm on the board.

onFailure.narration: The softer bed needs one clear held round to invite the wyrm on the board.

onAssisted.narration: The softer bed needs one clear held round to invite the wyrm on the board.

bed_slab.narration: Support a loose slab while the builder slides it below the wind lip. No one chips old ice to make a pillow.

interaction.cue: Support the loose slab at the hollow.

onSuccess.narration: The resting slab is ready. An invitation still needs two clear held rounds.

onFailure.narration: The resting slab is ready. An invitation still needs two clear held rounds.

onAssisted.narration: The resting slab is ready. An invitation still needs two clear held rounds.

lanes.narration: Move the empty benches so the people's withdrawal lane never crosses the broad route to the hollow. Solo heroes use the builders' fixed supports. One lunch bag is removed from duty as a barrier.

interaction.cue: Support the bench while the withdrawal lane is cleared.

onSuccess.narration: Both routes are clear; nobody stands between the wyrm and shelter.

onFailure.narration: Both routes are clear; nobody stands between the wyrm and shelter.

onAssisted.narration: Both routes are clear; nobody stands between the wyrm and shelter.

rest.narration: The builders lead you into a side alcove, away from the nest. They share oat cakes from a tool tin scrubbed clean for lunches. You rest on folded work blankets. One cake has the shape of a very blunt chisel.

choices.label: Rest before the encounter
Eat while a builder keeps watch

signal.narration: A builder raises a mitten for wait, spreads both palms for clear and lowers them to finish. Remember the observed signal round. These are builder signals, not instructions that control the wyrm.

interaction.cue: Watch the builder signals, then echo them.

onSuccess.narration: You can later show readers the checked signal round.

onFailure.narration: A builder will lead the readers by visible markers instead of crediting a guessed signal round.

onAssisted.narration: A builder will lead the readers by visible markers instead of crediting a guessed signal round.

offer.narration: The hollow is ready and the people are behind the benches. On the board you may drive the creatures from the doorway, or hold the quiet approach to invite the wyrm into the hollow. Only the held approach makes it your ally. Defeat means moving the reading work to the old room, not fighting again. You may use the ordinary two-round invitation without relying on the bedding, or choose the soft-bed advantage if you prepared it.

choices.label: Use the ordinary two-round invitation, or drive them clear
Use our soft bed for a one-round invitation

fight.narration: The frost wyrm rises and the loose bones rattle upright. Drive the creatures from the doorway, or hold the hollow approach for 2 clear rounds to invite the wyrm into shelter. The slick new-ice strip still slows anyone stopping there.

fight_soft.narration: The frost wyrm rises and the loose bones rattle upright. Drive the creatures from the doorway, or hold the hollow approach for 1 clear round to invite the wyrm into shelter. The slick new-ice strip still slows anyone stopping there.

room_clear.narration: The doorway is clear and the builders lower their mittens. The new room can be used without squeezing past a turning tail. The bench has a frost-wyrm-shaped dent; the builders decide it is now a special chair.

choices.label: Prepare the actual reading place

variants.text: The wyrm settles in the sheltered hollow through the opening. When a builder hums from the tunnel, it answers softly. You have a neighbor who will remember being given room.
The wyrm backs into the broad outer tunnel, leaving the readers' doorway. The builders leave the sheltered hollow available. It has not chosen the hollow.

room_moved.narration: The wyrm holds its doorway and your party withdraws behind the benches. The builders help you rest, then unroll the wall plan. "The room can go here," one says, pointing down the clear tunnel. The new reading room will open later, away from the nest. Nobody is sent back into the fight.

choices.label: Prepare the actual reading place

shelves.narration: Choose furniture for the room you actually have. The shelf kit can become a low shelf on sound floor here, or a temporary tabletop after unpacking. The folding kit can open in either room; after victory it also needs a separate low stand assembled.

variants.text: The new site needs more carving, and its floor cannot hold shelf blocks yet. For now only the broad table fits in the old room. The builders must finish the new chamber after you leave.

choices.label: Prepare our kit piece by piece as a table
Open the folded table in the old room
Build the low shelf on the won floor

shelf_build.narration: Support the low top while the builders secure its wide blocks. No shelf is fixed to the old ice.

unpack_shelf.narration: Pass the shelf pieces into position for a temporary tabletop. The broad top will hold the notes; the blocks stay loose until the replacement room is ready.

interaction.cue: Pass our kit pieces for the working table.

onSuccess.narration: The parts are ready to level as a tabletop.

onFailure.narration: The parts are ready to level as a tabletop.

onAssisted.narration: The parts are ready to level as a tabletop.

variants.text: Pass the folding kit's stand pieces to the builder. On this uneven threshold, the table needs its low stand. The builder consults the instruction sheet, which has unfolded into a small tent.

shelves_check.narration: Level the working table on checked floor. A sliding book is becoming a very short story. Nobody enters the unfinished replacement chamber after retreat.

onSuccess.narration: The notes have a steady working place.

onFailure.narration: The notes have a steady working place.

onAssisted.narration: The notes have a steady working place.

slab_route.narration: A resting slab used by the wyrm stays with the wyrm. If your prepared slab is unused, it can become a low step for readers; loose new snow is left where it was shaped.

choices.label: Recover the unused slab for a reader step
Leave the hollow undisturbed

reader_step.narration: Support the unused slab while the builder brings it back along the checked lane and sets a low step beside the notes. It is loose new ice, not a piece carved from the old wall.

interaction.cue: Support the unused slab for the low step.

onSuccess.narration: A low step now helps readers reach their notes.

onFailure.narration: A low step now helps readers reach their notes.

onAssisted.narration: A low step now helps readers reach their notes.

readers.narration: The readers wait with their notes in the old room. You can show the signal round you remembered, or place builders at visible corners and pass the bundles. Bring every reader to the furniture you actually prepared.

variants.text: The readers wait with their notes in the old room. Your builder will lead the visible-marker route. Pass the bundles from mitten to mitten until the readers reach their working place.
Today the lane stays inside the old room. You must get the notes past the crowded benches to the extra table.

choices.label: Show the remembered builder signals
Pass notes along the visible builder markers

readers_check.narration: Echo the builder signals while the readers watch from the safe lane. The round you saw was wait, clear, wait, finish; you may ask for help rather than guess.

interaction.cue: Show the checked signal round to the readers.

onSuccess.narration: The readers follow the checked round to their working place.

onFailure.narration: Use the visible builder markers and shared bundles instead of repeating a missed round.

onAssisted.narration: Use the visible builder markers and shared bundles instead of repeating a missed round.

readers_markers.narration: Pass the heavy bundles along builders who can see the next mitten. The route remains inside the old room if the doorway stayed occupied.

interaction.cue: Pass the note bundles along the visible markers.

onSuccess.narration: The readers and every bundle reach their working place.

onFailure.narration: The readers and every bundle reach their working place.

onAssisted.narration: The readers and every bundle reach their working place.

readers_clear.narration: The readers reach their safe working place with their notes.

choices.label: Agree on quiet neighbor rules

variants.text: Their working place is a crowded corner of the old room. The new chamber is still a building job, with tools and blankets needed for another day.

quiet.narration: Choose one useful agreement for readers and builders. Nobody promises that a wild wyrm will obey a sign. The new rule is for the people holding the chisels.

options.label: Keep the tools padded
options.reaction: The builder re-hats the largest chisel.

options.label: Keep the nest margin visible
options.reaction: Readers can see where not to stand.

options.label: Keep notes off the walking lane
options.reaction: The smallest reader carries the last loose page.

onSuccess.narration: The readers can work without anyone testing the old ice.

onFailure.narration: The readers can work without anyone testing the old ice.

onAssisted.narration: The readers can work without anyone testing the old ice.

ending.narration: The readers have room for their notes. The wyrm has room to rest. The old ice stays quiet. A builder hangs the chisel hats beside the doorway and adds one last reminder: no scraping near the neighbor. You leave a glacier where people and wyrm have more room because your party made it.

variants.text: From the sheltered hollow comes a soft answering rumble. The builders will keep that approach open if your party needs help here again.
The new chamber must wait. Today the readers share their old room with the extra table, and the builders give up their free morning to finish the move.
The unused resting slab has become a low reader step. Nothing was taken from beneath the wyrm.
The folding kit is now a working table, in the room the readers can actually use.
The shelf kit stands as a low shelf on the checked floor; the readers can reach it without climbing.
Your nest diagram records the tail pattern your party observed.
The builder-checked nest margin stays labeled as a helped observation.
